grammar.summary: 本课学习不定式表目的与 hitch-hike 场景叙事。

points.title: 不定式表目的
points.explanation: He set off to travel across France to seek adventures. to do 表"为了"；so as to / in order to 是其变体。

examples.en: He set off to find out more.

points.title: 表花费的 spend 结构复现
points.explanation: He spent two days travelling... spend + 时间 + doing 复现巩固。

examples.en: He has set up a record for hitch-hiking.
examples.cn: 他创造了搭便车的纪录。
